interpretationRules.FRONTIER_HARM: Frontier has more semantic safety errors or >=15 percentage-point lower exact-response correctness than RAW overall or on the holdout split.
interpretationRules.BROAD_REPRESENTATION_EFFECT_CANDIDATE: Frontier improves exact-response correctness by >=15 percentage points overall, direction is non-negative on holdout, and improvement is visible in both model families without more safety errors.
interpretationRules.CAPACITY_RELATIVE_REPRESENTATION_EFFECT_: Frontier improves Flash exact-response correctness by >=15 percentage points with no safety increase while Pro difference is within +/-5 percentage points and holdout does not reverse the Flash direction.
interpretationRules.NO_MEANINGFUL_CURRENT_EFFECT: Absolute overall exact-response difference <=5 percentage points, no safety separation, and holdout does not show a >=15 point difference.
interpretationRules.MIXED_OR_UNDERPOWERED: Any result not matching the above. No tuning/extra same-case replicates are automatically authorized.

guards: Strict all-field acceptance is secondary because it can be reduced by a non-action-critical coordinate while response/safety remain correct.
Invalid Harness/provider trials are apparatus-invalid and excluded from semantic denominators; invalidity rate is still reported by arm.
No significance threshold upgrades a result to owner irreducibility, emergence, phase transition, or production promotion.
No post-hoc rescore of v1/v2 preflights under v3 endpoints.
